context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT Authentication system fully tested and working: 1) Cookie-based auth with httpOnly access_token and refresh_token. 2) Admin user seeded on startup (admin@studyforge.com / admin123). 3) All existing data migrated to admin user. 4) Protected routes: /goals, /pomodoro require auth; /notes, /analytics are public. 5) Goals CRUD with progress tracking and confirm dialog on delete. 6) Pomodoro timer with session logging and today's stats. 7) Bookmarks and confidence ratings work on notes/practice tests. 8) Rate limiting on AI endpoints (10/minute). 9) Brute force protection on login (5 attempts, 15 min lockout). 10) Frontend uses AuthContext with axios withCredentials:true and 401 interceptor for token refresh.
